items.title: Claude Cowork 推出跨工具統一記憶，客戶 Brief 再也不用重複交代
items.title_en: Claude Cowork Launches Unified Memory Across Chat and Agent Tools
items.summary: Anthropic 為 Claude Cowork 加入共享記憶，Chat 同 Cowork 之間脈絡即時共通，用戶可查看、編輯或刪除儲存內容，敏感資料受預設保護。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Claude Cowork now shares memory with standard chat — context carries across tools in real time. Users can view, edit, or delete stored memories; sensitive data like health or political info excluded by default.
items.why: 客戶 Brief、品牌偵好一次講清，之後每次用都記住，佳返重複交代工作。
items.why_en: No more re-briefing Claude on client tone or campaign history — persistent memory across tools cuts repetitive onboarding per task.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 自研 Jalapeño 專用推理隧片，比 Nvidia Blackwell 延遲快 1.7−3.6 倍
items.title_en: OpenAI Reveals Jalapeño Custom Chip: Up to 3.6x Lower Latency Than Nvidia Blackwell
items.summary: OpenAI 公開 Jalapeño 隧片數據：延遲比 Nvidia Blackwell 快 1.7−3.6 倍、每瓦效能高 1.5−1.9 倍，年底開始部署，目標大幅降低 AI 推理成本。
items.summary_en: OpenAI unveiled Jalapeño benchmarks at Hot Chips: 1.7–3.6x lower latency and 1.5–1.9x better performance-per-watt vs. Nvidia Blackwell. Limited deployment starts late 2026, built with Broadcom.
items.why: 推理成本跌會令 AI API 費用長遠減，大規模廣告內容自動化成本預算可以更漂亮。
items.why_en: Cheaper inference costs signal lower AI API pricing ahead — enabling more aggressive automation budgets for large-scale ad content production.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Hugging Face 傳言接受收購洽洽，估値逾 130 億美元
items.title_en: Hugging Face Reportedly in Acquisition Talks at $13B+ Valuation
items.summary: Business Insider 報道 Hugging Face 正接觸潛在買家，估値逾 130 億美元，較 2023 年估値升近4 倍，買家身份未支露。
items.summary_en: Hugging Face is reportedly fielding acquisition offers at $13B+ — nearly triple its 2023 valuation. No deal finalized; buyer identity undisclosed. Banks engaged to evaluate competing bids.
items.why: Hugging Face 係全球 AI 模型共享中橞，一旦被大企收購，開源模型取用方式階時改變，要評估工作流程依賴風險。
items.why_en: Hugging Face hosts most AI tool infrastructure. An acquisition could change access terms or open-source availability — worth tracking for workflow dependencies.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic 推出 MCP 企業統一授權管理，多工具 AI 接入一次搞定
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Enterprise-Managed Auth for MCP — Centralized AI Access Across Tools
items.summary: Anthropic 推出 MCP 企業統一授權，透公司身份系統統一管理 Slack、Figma、Notion 等工具嘅 AI 接入，唔使逐個工具單独授權。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched centralized enterprise auth for MCP connectors — organizations manage Claude’s access to Slack, Figma, Notion, Asana through a single identity provider. No more per-tool OAuth flows.
items.why: 廣告公司管理多個工具嘅 AI 接入更容易，合規風險大減， IT 部門落手機會更少。
items.why_en: Agencies managing Claude across multiple client tools can now centralize access control — less IT friction, easier compliance sign-off.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 2026 年逆 13 名高管離職，IPO 計劃推後至 2027 年
items.title_en: OpenAI Loses 13+ Senior Executives in 2026 as IPO Pushed to 2027
items.summary: OpenAI 2026 年至今已逾 13 名高管離職，包括 COO、CRO、CMO 及倫理主管，IPO 計劃已推後至 2027 年，準備委員會據報被解散。
items.summary_en: OpenAI lost 13+ senior leaders in 2026 including COO, CRO, CMO, and ethics chief. IPO pushed to 2027; preparedness team reportedly disbanded, raising investor and safety community concerns.
items.why: OpenAI 管理層動盪影響產品穩定性及 API 可靠度預期，評估供應商策略時要計入風險。
items.why_en: C-suite instability raises questions about OpenAI product roadmap continuity and API reliability — factor this into long-term vendor risk assessments.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: AI 廣告量度問題根源係管治，平台自報數難以獨立核實
items.title_en: AI Ad Measurement Problem Is Really a Governance Gap, Not a Tech Issue
items.summary: Digiday 分析指 AI 廣告量度難題核心係數據由平台自己持有，獨立核實無從入手。IAB 正制定框架，預計 2026 年11 月出結果。ChatGPT Ads 已擴至歐洲 31 個市場。
items.summary_en: Digiday flags AI ad measurement as a governance gap: platforms hold their own data, independent verification is impossible. IAB framework due November 2026; ChatGPT Ads expanding to 31 European markets with CPC pricing.
items.why: AI 廣告投放效益要靠平台自己報數，風險同第三方 cookie 消失一樣大，向客戶結報時要帶入這個假設。
items.why_en: AI ad ROI relies entirely on platform-reported data with no independent check — carry this caveat when presenting AI campaign results to clients.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 品牌大量湧入 Reddit，導致 ChatGPT 對 Reddit 引用率四日內急跌 86%
items.title_en: Brand Rush to Reddit Triggered 86% Collapse in ChatGPT Citations Within Four Days
items.summary: 品牌為入 LLM 搜尋結果大量進駐 Reddit，部分更用假帳號。結果 Reddit 在 ChatGPT 嘅引用率四日內跌逾 86%。Google AI Overviews 引用率未受影響。
items.summary_en: Brands flooded Reddit to game LLM citations, some via fake accounts. ChatGPT citations for Reddit dropped 86% in four days. Google AI Overviews unaffected — platform detection of manipulation is fast.
items.why: GEO（生成式搜尋優化）靠刷假帳號適得其反，要建立真實可信度而選短線刷曝光。
items.why_en: Gaming GEO with fake accounts backfires immediately. Authentic brand credibility in AI citations beats manufactured presence — clients need a real GEO content strategy now.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Omnicom 將建構 Omni AI 平台嘅 468 名工程師外判予 Endava
items.title_en: Omnicom Offloads 468 Omni AI Platform Engineers to Third-Party Contractor Endava
items.summary: Omnicom 將至少 468 名建構 Omni AI 平台嘅產品及工程人員轉移至外判商 Endava，另有約 50 名美國員工遷裁員。Omni 係 Omnicom 在 CES 大力宣傳嘅 AI 核心系統。
items.summary_en: Omnicom transferred at least 468 Omni AI platform engineers to contractor Endava, plus 50 US layoffs. Omni — showcased at CES as Omnicom’s AI cornerstone — is now outsourced to a third party.
items.why: 大型 Holdco 宣傳自建 AI 平台，實際卻係外判。Pitch 時要問清 AI 能力係自主研發還係包裝。
items.why_en: Holdcos claim proprietary AI capabilities but outsource the build. Ask hard questions in pitches about whether AI tools are truly in-house or contractor-built.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 創作者攻克演算法了，攻克 AI 搜尋呢？ KOL 策略要更新
items.title_en: Creators Cracked the Algorithm — Now They Must Crack AI Search. KOL Strategy Needs an Update
items.summary: Marketing-Interactive 分析指， AI 代理式搜尋令 KOL 發現渠道由社交演算法轉移。亞洲封閉平台（小紅書、抖音、微信）難被 AI 索引，創作者要靠播客、文章等開放渠道建立「機器可讀信譽」。
items.summary_en: Marketing-Interactive analysis: AI agentic search shifts creator discovery away from social algorithms. Asia’s walled-garden platforms (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat) resist AI indexing — creators need open-web presence via podcasts and articles.
items.why: 揀 KOL 兌再靠粉絲數，要看佔 AI 搜尋可見度。小紅書、抖音圈圈外嘅開放渠道佈局，已是 KOL 策略新考量。
items.why_en: KOL selection must now factor in AI search visibility, not just follower count. Open-web presence outside Xiaohongshu and Douyin is a new KOL evaluation criterion for GBA-market campaigns.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 抖音「饋貓外賣」：假裝落單實為儲錢，雙重目的是數據同錢包生態
items.title_en: Douyin Launches ‘Greedy Cat Takeout’: Fake Ordering That Collects Data and Deepens Payment Lock-In
items.summary: 抖音推出「饋貓外賣」，模仿真實外賣體驗，用戶「落單」後錢存入平台錢包而非真正消費。雙重目的：收集用戶飲食偵好數據，以及將資金留在抖音支付生態圈內。
items.summary_en: Douyin Pay launched a fake food delivery feature mirroring real ordering UX — money goes into a platform wallet, not real orders. Dual purpose: collecting food preference data and deepening Douyin Pay ecosystem lock-in.
items.why: 電商平台用「用戶體驗」包裝數據收集同錢包鎖定，係而家大陸平台常見打法。做大陸電商投放要理解這類平台策略。
items.why_en: Douyin wraps data collection and payment lock-in as user benefit — a blueprint for how Chinese platforms deepen commerce engagement. Essential context for any brand running Douyin commerce campaigns.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 阿里通義萬相 Wan 3.0 正式上線：支援 30 秒影片生成，廣告業已入批量生產流程
items.title_en: Alibaba Wan 3.0 Launches: 30-Second Video Generation Ready for Ad Production Pipelines
items.summary: Wan 3.0 支援最長 30 秒影片生成，接受 doc/xls/ppt/pdf 輸入，角色一致性、道具、空間關係全面升級，業界評價「穩定、真實、有質感」，已進入廣告業批量生產流程。
items.summary_en: Alibaba’s Wan 3.0 generates up to 30-second videos from text or documents (doc/xls/ppt/pdf), with improved character consistency and style fidelity. Industry feedback: realistic enough for commercial ad use; already in batch production.
items.why: 廣告影片製作成本可大幅佳返，1080P 折扎價每秒 ¥0.84，即刻可用於品牌影片及短劇廣告。
items.why_en: Cuts ad video production costs significantly — 1080P promo pricing ~¥0.84/sec. Style consistency makes it ready for commercial campaigns now.

items.title: 生數科技（Vidu 母公司）公布幾用世界模型五級發展路線，L1–L3 已實現
items.title_en: Shengshu AI (Vidu Parent) Unveils Five-Level World Model Roadmap at WRC 2026 — L1–L3 Realized
items.summary: 生數科技創辦人在世界機器人大會提出五級框架：L1 影片生成（Vidu）、L2 互動世界（Vidu S1）、L3 可操控實體空間（Motubrain），L1–L3 已實現。
items.summary_en: Shengshu AI founder presented a five-level world model roadmap at WRC 2026: L1 video gen (Vidu), L2 interactive worlds (Vidu S1), L3 physical robot control (Motubrain). Levels 1–3 are already realized.
items.why: Vidu 係廣告常用影片生成工具，了解其技術路線有助評估未來互動廣告及沉浸式內容製作可能性。
items.why_en: Vidu is widely used for ad video creation. Understanding its roadmap helps anticipate interactive ad formats and immersive content capabilities in near-term product cycles.

items.title: Stability AI 獲環球音樂巨頭及 EA 入股，AI 創作版權生態正在形成
items.title_en: Stability AI Raises $76M from Universal Music, Sony, Warner and EA — AI Creative Rights Ecosystem Taking Shape
items.summary: Stability AI 完成 7,600 萬美元 B 輪融資，投資方包括環球音樂、Sony Music、Warner Music 及 EA，屬策略性入股，現時總融資達 2.32 億美元。
items.summary_en: Stability AI closed a $76M Series B from Universal Music, Sony Music, Warner Music, and EA — strategic co-development partners, not just investors. Total funding reaches $232M.
items.why: 三大唱片公司入股代表 AI 生成內容版權問題正在行業層面獲解決，對用 AI 製作品牌音樂及影片嘅 marketer 係正面訊號。
items.why_en: Major label investment signals industry-level resolution on AI content rights — good news for marketers using AI-generated music and visuals in brand campaigns.

items.title: AI 簡報工具 Gamma 收購電商行銷影片初創 Lica，指向一站式 Brief 至影片工作流程
items.title_en: Gamma Acquires E-Commerce Marketing Video Startup Lica — Brief-to-Video Workflow on the Horizon
items.summary: Gamma（1 億+ 用戶）收購 Lica， Lica 專門將截圖及錄製內容轉化為電商品牌行銷影片。兩位聯合創辦人將領導 Gamma 新設研究部門，專注個人化多模態傳播格式。
items.summary_en: Gamma (100M+ users) acquired Lica, which converts screenshots and recordings into brand-aligned e-commerce marketing videos. Lica founders lead a new Gamma research division on personalized multimodal communication.
items.why: AI 簡報工具整合品牌影片生成，未來有機會做到一站式由 Brief 生成提案及配套影片，要留意 Gamma 產品路線。
items.why_en: AI presentation tools merging with brand video creation — watch Gamma’s roadmap for potential all-in-one brief-to-deck-to-video workflows for brand marketers.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Visa 大中華區：AI Agent 將直接代替人類完成交易，傳統廣告漏斗面臨根本性改變
items.title_en: Visa Greater China: AI Agents Will Execute Purchases Autonomously, Disrupting the Entire Ad Funnel
items.summary: Visa 大中華區總裁指出 AI Agent 正從「人搜服務」轉變為「服務主動理解人」， AI 代理將自主比較、決定、完成購買，傳統廣告漏斗面臨根本性改變。
items.summary_en: Visa Greater China President argues AI agents are shifting commerce from passive search to proactive service delivery — agents will autonomously compare, decide, and complete purchases, disrupting traditional advertising funnels.
items.why: 當 AI Agent 代替消費者揀選產品，SEO 同廣告競投邏輯都要改寫，而家要理解 AI 電商授權及身份框架。
items.why_en: When AI agents replace human brand-choice decisions, ad bidding and SEO logic become obsolete. Understand AI commerce authorization frameworks before it affects campaign ROI.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Marc Jacobs 全球首部中國市場微短劇《 The Swap 》上線
items.title_en: Marc Jacobs Debuts First Micro-Drama for Chinese Market: 'The Swap'
items.summary: Marc Jacobs 推出首部微短劇《 The Swap 》，以 Scene Bag 為主角道具，繼 Gucci 後又一奨奈奇品牌游用微短劇形式做品牌內容行銷。
items.summary_en: Marc Jacobs launched its first micro-drama 'The Swap,' centering its Scene Bag as the plot device. Follows Gucci in adopting China’s micro-drama format for luxury brand storytelling tied to its fall collection launch.
items.why: 微短劇而家中國市場高效觸達年輕受眾嘅品牌內容格式，奈奇品牌帶頭入場代表形式正式主流化。香港代理服務大陸品牌可將此列入提案選項。
items.why_en: Luxury brands adopting micro-drama signals format mainstreaming for China-market brand content. Agencies pitching China campaigns should now include micro-drama as a standard format option.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: AI 行銷系統 Hightouch 挡走 Google 代理關係負責人，直接對準代理預算
items.title_en: Hightouch Poaches Google’s Top Agency Lead to Target Agency Budgets Directly
items.summary: 估値 27.5 億美元的 Hightouch 聘請前 Google 20 年資深代理合作夥伴 Jitendra Kumar 出任廣告業務負責人。平台已由客戶數據平台轉型為「 AI 代理式行銷系統」。
items.summary_en: Hightouch ($2.75B valuation) hired 20-year Google veteran Jitendra Kumar to lead agency and brand partnerships. The platform repositioned from CDP to ‘agentic marketing system’ competing directly for agency budgets.
items.why: AI 驅動嘅行銷數據工具正面挑戰傳統媒體預算分配，代理商要留意這個新競爭者。
items.why_en: Hightouch is targeting agency budgets directly — this agentic marketing platform could disrupt how agencies handle data activation and media planning workflows.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Instagram First Draft：10 秒自動剪 Reels，廣告內容發布速度再升級
items.title_en: Instagram First Draft: Auto-Edit Reels in Under 10 Seconds — iPhone Rollout Now Live
items.summary: Instagram 新功能 First Draft 自動修剪所選片段、移除停頓、組合精華片段，全程少於 10 秒， iPhone 先行推出，與 CapCut Auto Cut 及 Adobe Firefly Quick Cuts 直接競爭。
items.summary_en: Instagram’s First Draft auto-trims clips, removes pauses, and assembles highlights in under 10 seconds — keeping creators inside the app. iPhone rollout. Competes directly with CapCut Auto Cut and Adobe Firefly.
items.why: 創作者兌使離開 Instagram 就完成剪片，縮短 Reels 製作流程，品牌內容排期可以更快。
items.why_en: Creators stay in-app for editing, cutting Reels turnaround time. Brands can publish social content faster without relying on CapCut or separate editing tools.

items.title: Anthropic 投入 500 萬美元研究 AI 對用戶身心健康嘅影響，品牌安全評估即將有客觀標準
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches $5M Research Program on AI’s Impact on User Wellbeing — Brand Safety Benchmarks Coming
items.summary: Anthropic 推出 500 萬美元研究資助計劃，資助獨立研究機構建立開源評估工具，量度 AI 對用戶身心健康嘅正負面影響，申請截止 9 月21 日。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched a $5M grant program funding independent research to build open-source evaluations measuring AI’s impact on user wellbeing — covering harmful and beneficial effects. Applications due September 21.
items.why: 品牌用 AI 做客服或內容互動前，即將有客觀標準評估風險，有助制定負責任的 AI 使用政策。
items.why_en: Brands deploying AI for customer interactions will soon have independent benchmarks to assess ethical and reputational risks — useful for building responsible AI deployment policies with clients.
